name: Arabian Plastic Industrial Company Limited
summary: Arabian Plastic Industrial Co. Ltd. engages in the provision of injection molding production services, as well as extrusion of films, blow molding and thermoforming disposable products. Its activities include the production of plastic in its primary forms, plastic cans, boxes, bottles & bags, and wholesale of primary plastics, rubber and synthetic fibers. The company was founded on January 27, 1993 and is headquartered in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
